fnol_text: My name is Ethan Thorne and I live at 875 Heather Close, Springfield, OH 45597. You can reach me on (555) 208-6710 or ethan.thorne@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 24 February 2024 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2023-00078. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Thorne on (555) 208-6710 to acknowledge the claim. Ethan confirmed the loss date as 24 February 2024.
Site visit to 875 Heather Close. Neighbour Naomi Lindqvist was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Priya Brennan sustained whiplash and was treated at St. Brendan's Hospital. Do not admit liability; refer.
